CustomWeapons – 3D weapon models (draft)

Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. The small grey box is how the item shows in the inventory slot. Bow and crossbow have a dropdown for their draw stages. Attack plays the weapon's attack animation (the motion the pack adds on top of the hand pose for half a second after an ability fires).

World effects

What every player sees in the world when an ability lands, pack or not: these are real blocks placed and moved by the server around the target (the grey figure). Drag to look around; the effect loops.
